item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description:
Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a lot of check-ins and pauses built in, which makes it easy to tie water to them. Most people under-drink when they're busy, and it shows up as low focus and a shorter fuse. Dehydration also makes stress feel heavier than it is. Keep water within reach, and let each pause be your cue.
Action: Drink a full glass of water right now, before your next task.
